sv.title: MP: Köper inte hela totalpaketet
sv.summary: Miljöpartiet (MP) köper inte det så kallade totalpaket som Socialdemokraterna har tagit fram. – Nej, totalpaketet var väldigt tydligt ett S-bud till Centerpartiet, säger MP:s ekonomisk-politiska talesperson Janine Alm Ericson.

en.title: MP: Not buying the whole package
en.summary: The Green Party (MP) is not buying the so-called total package that the Social Democrats (S) have put forward. - No, the total package was very clearly an S offer to the Centre Party, says MP's economic policy spokesperson Janine Alm Ericson.
